instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Confirm, cancel, complete or mark a booking as a no-show, only in the ways a booking may move", and give it booking_id; to (The new status, like confirmed or cancelled).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:change-a-booking-status and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Moves one booking record to a new status: waiting bookings can be confirmed or cancelled, a confirmed one can be completed, marked no-show or cancelled, and a finished one never moves.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: booking (records:read, records:list, records:write); booking-book (records:read, records:write).
